The '''Duel in the Sith Sanctum''' was a power play between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Skotia]] and [[Darth Zash]]. On Zash's orders, her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], engaged and killed Skotia in the [[Sith Sanctum]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR:GK" />

==Prelude==
In [[3643 BBY]], Skotia learned of [[Darth Zash]]'s attempts to unlock the secrets of an artifact of [[Tulak Hord]]. He sent one of his apprentices, [[Ortosin]], and two agents to [[Duel in the Sith Academy|assassinate]] her [[Darth Nox|new apprentice]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] but they failed. When the apprentice arrived on Dromund Kaas, Skotia intercepted the Inquisitor at the spaceport and attempted to intimidate them. News of this infuriated Zash. Knowing that she couldn't kill Skotia, for a power play would make the [[Dark Council]] nervous, she decided to dispatch her apprentice, [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], instead to infiltrate Skotia's [[Darth Skotia's bunker|base]], which was guarded by Skotia's army-sized [[Darth Skotias' Guard|force]].<ref name="TOR:GK" />

==The Duel==
[[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|Gathering]] a [[Trandoshan relic|tablet]] that would force Skotia's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bodyguards, [[Skeesk]] and [[Skarsk]], to abandon him and a [[Cyber neutralizer|cyborg prototype disruptor]] that could disable someone who is mostly cyborg, the Apprentice confronted Skotia in his chambers with [[Khem Val]] and the Sith Lord. Skotia killed the bodyguards when they turned on him, but the cyborg disruptor greatly weakened him enough to be killed. Skotia was defeated, and his cybernetics weakened him from the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]], and he was no match against the powerful Inquisitor. With his last breath, Skotia realized that Zash must have spent years plotting his demise, and realized that the Sith would always betray one another. He warned her apprentice that she would turn on them before he died.<ref name="TOR:GK" />
